name: Ellie Language
description: A type-safe programming language that runs on embedded and sandboxed environments — with a portable engine that shrinks to as little as 49KB.
longDescription: Ellie is a compiled, type-safe language I designed and built from scratch — parser, compiler, bytecode virtual machine, and CLI tooling. It targets resource-constrained and sandboxed environments (embedded, IoT, cloud functions) with compile-time safety, a low memory footprint, and per-device error recovery. The ecosystem includes an online playground, a package manager (Lia), and full documentation.

name: UtilStation
description: An all-in-one collection of 28+ fast, well-designed developer utilities — formatters, converters, generators, and inspectors, with no installs or sign-up.
longDescription: UtilStation brings the tools developers reach for daily into one place: JSON/JS/HTML/CSS formatters, Base64 / JWT / URL inspectors, UUID / ULID / QR / cron / hash generators, JSON↔TypeScript/YAML and CSV↔JSON converters, a regex tester, a cURL converter, and more — fast, reliable, and beautifully designed.

name: Rust-NMEA
description: A Rust parser for the NMEA 0183 protocol used in GPS and marine navigation, with u-blox support.
longDescription: A robust Rust library for parsing NMEA 0183 sentences — the protocol behind GPS receivers and marine navigation hardware. Built for real-time use with careful error handling and support for common sentence types and u-blox devices.

name: Menemen
description: A streaming HTTP/HTTPS request library for Rust, built for low-overhead network I/O.
longDescription: A Rust library for efficient streaming HTTP/HTTPS requests, focused on performance and a small memory footprint. Designed for applications that stream large responses without buffering everything in memory — and used as the networking layer in several of my other projects.

name: Wole (CLI)
description: A Wake-on-LAN magic-packet generator, sender, and listener CLI written in Rust.
longDescription: A fast command-line tool written in Rust for Wake-on-LAN. Generates and sends magic packets to remotely wake devices on your network, and can also listen for incoming magic packets — a small, dependency-light systems utility.

name: WoleApp
description: A Wake-on-LAN magic-packet generator & sender for Android, built with Flutter.
longDescription: An Android app built with Flutter that sends Wake-on-LAN magic packets to remotely wake devices on your network. Clean interface for managing multiple saved devices and network configurations.

name: event_listener
description: A Node.js-style event listener library for Dart (also ported to Rust as rust_event_listener).
longDescription: A Dart library that brings familiar Node.js-style event handling to Dart and Flutter apps, with a simple API for event-driven patterns. Published on pub.dev, and later ported to Rust as rust_event_listener.

name: SafeEn
description: A local database with clean, strict data integrity and easy portability, written in Rust.
longDescription: A Rust-based local database focused on data integrity and portability. Designed for applications that need reliable local storage with strong consistency guarantees and simple deployment across environments. Published on crates.io as safe_en.

name: Bnots
description: A note-taking app that combines simplicity with Markdown support, built with Flutter.
longDescription: A cross-platform note-taking app built with Flutter, featuring Markdown support and a clean, distraction-free interface. Made for people who want a simple yet capable tool for organizing their thoughts.

name: Device-Database
description: A JavaScript library that detects and identifies development boards and IoT devices (Raspberry Pi, Orange Pi, and more).
longDescription: A JavaScript library that detects and identifies development boards, single-board computers, and IoT hardware. Useful for tools and applications that need to adapt to whatever board they're running on. Published on npm as device-database.

name: rpifan
description: An automatic CPU-temperature fan controller service for Raspberry Pi.
longDescription: A Node.js service that automatically controls a cooling fan on a Raspberry Pi based on CPU temperature, with configurable thresholds and smooth speed control for quiet, efficient thermal management. One of my earliest open-source projects.
